idea-plugin.name: Mobile Test Bench
idea-plugin.description:
Mirror and control Android and iOS devices in an IDE tool window, and inspect their UI with locators for Mobilewright and Appium.

Features

  • Mirror and control: Android emulator (live stream and input through the emulator gRPC API), Android devices (adb), iOS simulators (mobilecli, WebDriverAgent fallback)
  • Inspector: element tree, properties, highlight on screen, Mobilewright and Appium locator suggestions with duplicate detection
  • Recorder and player: record taps, swipes and text into a script, add assertions, replay it
  • Device Tools tabs: logs, performance, files, crashes and more
  • Show Locator on Device: highlight the elements a locator in your test code matches (editor menu, Tools menu, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M)
  • Device power actions, automatic reconnect and a settings page

Requirements

  • IntelliJ-based IDE 2025.3 or newer
  • mobilecli on the PATH (used for device discovery, hierarchy dumps and iOS)
  • adb from the Android SDK for Android devices and emulators
  • macOS with Xcode (simctl) for iOS simulators

Not tried on a physical iPhone or Android phone.

action.description: Highlight the elements the locator under the caret (or the selection) matches on the connected device
